newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Van Leer in Turkish joint venture.
newsitem.headline: Van Leer in Turkish joint venture.

text.p: Dutch packaging group Van Leer said on Friday it was setting up a joint venture in Turkey.
Van Leer said it had agreed with Turkish firm SAF Plastik Sanayi ve Ticaret AS to set up a flexible consumer packaging joint venture to be called Van Leer SAF.
Van Leer will pay 24 million guilders in cash for 60 percent of the shares in the joint venture while 40 percent will be held by the Eskinazi family, former owners of SAF Plastik.
Van Leer said the joint venture will have annual sales of some 50 million guilders and will immediately make a positive contribution to Van Leer's earnings per share.
Van Leer has operated a steel drum factory in Turkey since 1990: Van Leer Mimaysan Ambalaj Sanayi AS.
